# Docify (docifydocai.com)

> Docify is a documentation automation platform: it generates standards-grade technical and business documentation from repositories using Claude, scores every document against a deterministic quality rubric, and estimates how ready the content is for ChatGPT, Claude, and Google Gemini to retrieve and cite — a modeled readiness signal, not a ranking guarantee — before it is published.

## What Docify does

- Generates API references, quick starts, user guides, installation guides, release notes, and business documents directly from GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket repositories (read-only access; source code is never stored).
- Scores every generated page against an enterprise documentation rubric: structure, titles, metadata, clarity, examples, and citation-readiness. The scoring is deterministic and rule-based — the same document always produces the same score.
- Estimates per-assistant AI search readiness (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) as a modeled signal and shows the exact fixes that raise the score.
- Exports to DITA, Markdown, HTML, DocBook, ePub, PDF, and Word.
- Automation pipelines regenerate affected documents on every merge, re-score them against your quality gate, and publish the result to your Docify workspace and export centre — never back into your repository (webhooks for GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket).
